# Vendored tree-sitter CSV parser

`src/parser.c.gz` and `src/tree_sitter/parser.h` are the generated `csv`
grammar assets from
[`tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-csv`](https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-csv)
revision `f6bf6e35eb0b95fbadea4bb39cb9709507fcb181` (master after `v1.2.0`)
with `rfc4180-quotes.patch` applied, regenerated by tree-sitter CLI 0.25.10.

That revision includes upstream commit `4934ce2` ("fix: properly parse text
starting with a number"). Before it, the `text` token needed at least two
characters, so single-character fields such as `a` in `a,1` failed to parse.
The same commit also let unquoted fields contain any quote. The patch restores
RFC 4180 quoting: unquoted fields contain no `"`, so `"unterminated` and
`"a"b` are parse errors rather than text. Upstream's test corpus passes with
the patch. `node js/scripts/build-vendored-grammars.mjs --only csv` reapplies
it and requires the regenerated parser to equal `src/parser.c.gz`.
The `tree-sitter-csv` crate is not used because its last release (1.2.0)
predates that fix and pins `cc ~1.0.82`, which conflicts with other grammar
crates.

The uncompressed `parser.c` SHA-256 is
`eacf58622b8d50ab75acf91172d35e314874327d98d1bd03acfd1ab789ddb1d1`.
The `parser.h` SHA-256 is
`180b893c8734778fd32f372dfbc27bd6ad1cd2221f26150b31256ff6716320d2`.

The grammar is MIT licensed; see `LICENSE`. `build.rs` expands the
deterministically compressed parser into Cargo's output directory before
compilation.
